svg.text: The Big Picture — agents: answers → OUTCOMES · the loop is in the repo
🔁 PART 1 — THE MACHINE (lessons 1–5)
📋 answers vs outcomes
a chatbot recites from memory;
an agent gets a GOAL, a to-do
mindset and a hall pass 🎫
🔁 the loop: think → act → observe
THINK = next-token reasoning, as text · ACT = the
harness runs a tool · OBSERVE = result onto the pad —
repeat, smarter each beat, until done {answer}
🧰 the belt · 📔 the pad
tools = name + label + schema + writes-flag; labels are
half the intelligence · scratchpad = working memory on
the small desk — compact it, externalize the durable
🚧 field-trip rules
MAX_STEPS curfew 🕐 · write gates —
reads flow, writes wait [y/N] · hardened
tools (no eval!) · every beat logged 🧾
🔬 the repo: agent/agent.py — ~130 lines, zero dependencies, no API key
TOOLS (belt + writes-flags + hardened calc) · BRAINS (ScriptedBrain demo · HumanBrain --drive · ← one LLM call slots here) ·
run() (curfew + gate + errors-as-observations + scratchpad) — every framework is this file with more adjectives
python3 agent/agent.py --drive — YOU are the brain: feel every beat from the inside 🧠
💥 PART 2 — REALITY (lessons 6–8)
💥 the five failure modes
1 compounding: wrong fact at step 2 → polished wrong
answer at step 9 · 2 loops: same act forever · 3 injection:
instructions hiding in tool results · 4 goal drift: helpful
side quests · 5 fake done: declared success, no outcome
📊 caught by EVALS: scored scenarios, outcome checks
👯 the five patterns (+ pattern zero)
🧍 solo doer (start here!) · 🗺️ planner + executor ·
🧑‍🏫 critic loop (best critics: test runners) ·
🚧 human-in-the-loop (drafts flow, signatures gate) ·
👯 the team (with a foreman & checkable artifacts)
🙅 zero: fixed steps? write a SCRIPT — no agent at all
🎼 drawn twice on the patterns page
every pattern: numbered flow diagram +
full sequence diagram — because every
pattern is the SAME loop, wrapped differently ·
handoffs are artifacts (files, PRs, JSON),
never vibes
🎓 the graduation skill: build one, break one, secure one, eval one — and know when to say "this doesn't need an agent" 🙅
siblings: the AI school (L11 = the aerial view) · the MCP school (where tool belts come from 🔌) ·
and the ops schools (Docker/K8s/AWS/ArgoCD) — because agents that touch production wear ALL the hats 🎩
